text:
nora: quick sync 1: proposing deterministic 'accrual windows' for trace cost attribution. current problem: multi-chunk and late-enrich traces get split across ingest windows -> billing spikes and heavy stitch queries.

nora: idea: derive a stable trace-key, then map that key deterministically to a window offset (sliding accrual window). all chunks fold to same accrual window even if spans arrive late.

sam: question: very late spans (hours)  backfill or overflow?

nora: two knobs: window_width (e.g., 5m) and late_horizon (e.g., 1h). within horizon fold; after horizon send to overflow bucket with best-effort tag.

maria: migration concern  historical billing diffs. dual-write or opt-in backfill? both costly.

jen: propose phased rollout: dual-path tags for comparison, sampled backfill/extrapolate deltas, exact reprocess opt-in.

alex: impl Q: compute trace-key at edge (low latency tagging) or gateway (single source of truth)? edge needs canonical SDK rules; gateway centralizes compute but more ingress CPU.

ria: canonicalization must be deterministic and resilient: example inputs tenant|service_fingerprint|root_span_id fallback to trace_id. spec must include fallbacks and header conventions.

sam: cardinality worry: will accrual-key index explode?

nora: estimate similar to active traces per window; prototype to validate.

jen: testing matrix: out-of-order, chunked, late-enrich, cross-region fanout, query perf comparison.

ci-bot: queued: accrual-sim -> integration-tests (ETA ~12m) :gear:

maria: backfill cost mitigation: sampled re-accumulate + extrapolation, only full reprocess if delta > threshold.

alex: multi-region hashes must match; include unit tests.

ria: I'll draft RFC appendix with: canonical key algorithm, versioned header names, window width, late horizon, overflow tag schema, dual-write header names, canary criteria.

sam: add metric accrual_window_mismatch_rate (cases where same logical trace maps to >1 accrual window). set canary threshold 0.1%.

jen: rollout plan: staging prototype -> 5% canary (non-billed) -> 25/50/100% with kill-switch. include customer diff report (7d).

nora: actions: - ria: draft appendix (EOD Wed) - alex: spike gateway vs edge (this week) - jen: telemetry sim harness (PR by Fri) - sam: add mismatch metric + dashboard - maria: ballpark sampled backfill cost (Thu)

alex: taking the gateway spike.

ria: sample naming suggestion: X-Accrual-Key-v1 header, and attribution_tag 'accrual-v2'.

jen: ping me if CI fails, I'll triage. :thumbsup: 

nora: i'll consolidate and post a short RFC addendum after ria's draft.

maria: this should quiet the weird billing spikes we've been debugging. :raised_hands:
